name: Riot Client (Valorant, League of Legends, TFT)
summary: Valorant and League of Legends do not run on any Linux today, so they are not supported on Lindos yet: Riot Vanguard is a Windows-only kernel anti-cheat, and whether that ever changes is up to Riot, their publisher (no date is given).
notes:
Valorant and (since 2024) League of Legends / Teamfight Tactics do not run on any Linux today, so they are not supported on Lindos yet: that is up to Riot, their publisher, and no date is given. They require Riot Vanguard, a kernel-level anti-cheat driver that only exists for Windows and must be running before the game starts. Wine and Proton cannot load Windows kernel drivers, and Riot deliberately blocks every Linux/Wine environment - there is no workaround, no 'special Wine', no VM trick that Riot allows (VMs are detected and banned). Anyone claiming otherwise is either out of date (pre-Vanguard League ran through Lutris until early 2024) or asking you to install something you should not.
The Riot Client installer itself (Install VALORANT.exe / live.na.exe) may open under Wine, but it will stop at 'Vanguard not installed' or fail during the download - do not bother.
What you can do on Lindos: play the many other competitive titles that do run (Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2 native; Apex is not; Overwatch 2, Marvel Rivals, Warframe, Helldivers 2 through Proton - see docs/COMPATIBILITY.md and areweanticheatyet.com), or keep a Windows installation for Riot titles and restart into it when you want to play ('lindos-game route valorant' or 'lindos-game route "League of Legends"'; Windows 11 needs TPM 2.0, Valorant also Secure Boot). No cloud-gaming service offers them: NVIDIA removed League of Legends from GeForce NOW on 1 May 2024 when Vanguard arrived (Vanguard refuses virtual machines), and Valorant was never offered there.

alternatives.name: Not supported yet
alternatives.how: Not possible on any Linux today: Vanguard kernel anti-cheat is Windows-only, so Valorant / League of Legends / TFT are not supported on Lindos yet; that is up to Riot, their publisher, and no date is given (see areweanticheatyet.com)

alternatives.name: Counter-Strike 2 / Dota 2 (native)
alternatives.how: Steam: lindos-game install steam - both run natively with anti-cheat

alternatives.name: Restart into Windows (dual boot)
alternatives.how: keep Windows on its own partition and restart into it to play: lindos-game route valorant shows how (Windows 11 needs TPM 2.0; Valorant also Secure Boot). No cloud service streams Valorant or League of Legends - GeForce NOW dropped League on 1 May 2024
